jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager (m/w/d) Endoscopy Schweiz

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur régional des ventes (m/f/d) Endoscopie Suisse

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Field-based

Als Regional Sales Manager (m/w/d) sind Sie für die fachliche und disziplinarische Leitung eines ca. 8-köpfigen Vertriebsteams für den Produktbereich Endoscopy (Sportmedizin, Visualisierung, OP-Infrastruktur/Vernetzung) in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Sie berichten an den Senior Business Unit Director Endoscopy für Deutschland, Schweiz und Österreich, sind Teil des Leadership Teams und arbeiten eng mit Produkt- und Key Account Management zusammen.

Das erwartet Sie:

• Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung des Vertriebsteams

• Coaching und Förderung der Mitarbeitenden zur Ausschöpfung ihrer individuellen Entwicklungspotenziale

• Betreuung, Ausbau und strategische Entwicklung von Key Accounts und Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in Kliniken und Spitälern

• Stärkung der Kundenbindung und Weiterentwicklung der Marktposition gemeinsam mit dem Vertriebsteam

• Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen sowie Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen zur Sicherung der Marktführerschaft

• Begleitung und Durchführung von Preisverhandlungen, Vertragsabschlüssen und Produktworkshops

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien zur marktgerechten Positionierung der Produkte

• Repräsentation des Unternehmens auf Fachmessen, Kongressen und Workshops

• Nutzung von Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsspielräumen zur erfolgreichen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebsregion Schweiz

Das bringen Sie mit
Erforderlich:

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb in der Medizintechnik mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen im Ausbau der Marktposition

• Erste Führungserfahrung in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld oder entsprechende Vorbereitung auf eine Führungsrolle durch Weiterbildungsprogramme sowie die Fähigkeit, Menschen zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln

• Ausgeprägte Verhandlungssicherheit und Begeisterungsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, Menschen für Themen zu gewinnen

• Erfahrung in der strategischen Planung

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Bevorzugt:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Gesundheitsökonomie, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Medizintechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung

• Erfahrung in der Vermarktung von Investitionsgütern, insbesondere durch effizientes Projektmanagement und den Einsatz von Finanzierungslösungen

• Erfahrung im Bereich Endoskopie/Sportmedizin

• Kenntnisse des Schweizer Gesundheitssystems sowie der dortigen Abrechnungs- und Rückerstattungssysteme

• Fundiertes Netzwerk im Klinik- und Spitalumfeld sowie ausgeprägte Netzwerkfähigkeit mit Freude am Aufbau und der Pflege von Beziehungen

• Gute Französisch- und/oder Italienischkenntnisse

Zusätzliche Informationen

• Reisetätigkeit beträgt ca. 70%.

• Je nach Planung Ihrer Arbeitswoche sind Sie die übrige Zeit im Home-Office.

• Ihr Wohnort sollte innerhalb der Schweiz liegen.

• Informationen zu dem Produktportfolio finden Sie unter folgenden Links: Visualisierung , Sportmedizin , OP-Infrastruktur und -Vernetzung

• Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Englisch ein.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen ungeachtet ihrer ethnischen, nationalen oder sozialen Herkunft, des Geschlechts, einer Behinderung, des Alters oder ihrer sexuellen Identität.

Travel Percentage: 70%

descriptionByLocale.it:
Flessibilità del lavoro: Come Regional Sales Manager (m/f/d), sei responsabile della gestione professionale e disciplinare di un team di vendita di circa 8 membri per l'area del prodotto Endoscopy (medicina sportiva, visualizzazione, infrastruttura operativa/networking) in Svizzera. Essi riportano al Senior Business Unit Director Endoscopy per la Germania, la Svizzera e l'Austria, fanno parte del team di leadership e lavorano a stretto contatto con il product and key account management. Questo è ciò che vi aspetta:
• Gestione professionale e disciplinare e ulteriore sviluppo del team di vendita
• Allenare e sostenere i dipendenti per sfruttare il loro potenziale di sviluppo individuale
• Sostegno, espansione e sviluppo strategico di account chiave e leader di opinioni chiave (KOL) in cliniche e ospedali
• Rafforzare la fidelizzazione del cliente e sviluppare ulteriormente la posizione di mercato insieme al team di vendita
• Effettuare analisi di mercato e di concorrenza e derivare misure mirate per garantire la leadership di mercato
• Sostegno e realizzazione di negoziati sui prezzi, conclusioni contrattuali e workshop sui prodotti
• Sviluppo e attuazione di strategie per il posizionamento orientato al mercato dei prodotti
• Rappresentanza dell'azienda a fiere, conferenze e workshop
• Utilizzare le modalità decisionali e di progettazione per la gestione riuscita e lo sviluppo della regione di vendita svizzera Questo è ciò che portano con loro. Richiesto:
• Diversi anni di esperienza nelle vendite in tecnologia medica con successo dimostrato nell'espansione della posizione di mercato
• Esperienza di leadership iniziale in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale o preparazione per la leadership attraverso programmi di formazione e la capacità di motivare e sviluppare le persone
• Forte certezza di negoziazione e entusiasmo, nonché la capacità di attirare le persone su argomenti
• Esperienza nella pianificazione strategica
• Conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese Preferibilmente:
• Studi completi in amministrazione aziendale, economia sanitaria, economia, tecnologia medica o disciplina comparabile
• Diversi anni di esperienza di leadership
• Esperienza nella commercializzazione dei beni di capitale, in particolare attraverso una gestione efficiente del progetto e l'utilizzo di soluzioni di finanziamento
• Esperienza nella medicina endoscopia/sport
• Conoscenza del sistema sanitario svizzero e dei sistemi di insediamento e rimborso
• Rete solida nell'ambiente ospedaliero e ospedaliero e forte capacità di networking con piacere nella costruzione e nel mantenimento delle relazioni
• Buona conoscenza del francese e/o italiano Ulteriori informazioni
• L'attività di viaggio è circa il 70%.
• A seconda della pianificazione del vostro workweek, siete il tempo rimanente nell'ufficio di casa.
• La vostra residenza dovrebbe essere all'interno della Svizzera.
• Le informazioni relative al portafoglio prodotti possono essere trovate sotto i seguenti link: Visualization, Sports Medicine, OP infrastruttura e networking
• Si prega di inviare i documenti di richiesta in inglese. La diversità è importante per noi. Accogliamo favorevolmente le domande da persone indipendentemente dalla loro origine etnica, nazionale o sociale, sesso, disabilità, età o identità sessuale. Percentuale di viaggio: 70%

Work Flexibility: Field-based As Regional Sales Manager (m/f/d), you are responsible for the professional and disciplinary management of an approximately 8-member sales team for the product area Endoscopy (sports medicine, visualization, operating infrastructure/networking) in Switzerland. They report to the Senior Business Unit Director Endoscopy for Germany, Switzerland and Austria, are part of the leadership team and work closely with product and key account management. This is what awaits you:
• Professional and disciplinary management and further development of the sales team
• Coaching and supporting employees to exploit their individual development potential
• Support, expansion and strategic development of key accounts and key opinion leaders (KOLs) in clinics and hospitals
• Strengthening customer loyalty and further developing the market position together with the sales team
• Carrying out market and competition analyses and deriving targeted measures to ensure market leadership
• Support and implementation of price negotiations, contract conclusions and product workshops
• Development and implementation of strategies for the market-oriented positioning of products
• Representation of the company at trade fairs, conferences and workshops
• Use of decision-making and design leeway for the successful management and further development of the Swiss sales region This is what they bring with them. Required:
• Several years of experience in sales in medical technology with proven success in expanding the market position
• Initial leadership experience in an international work environment or preparation for leadership through training programs and the ability to motivate and develop people
• Strong negotiating certainty and enthusiasm as well as the ability to attract people to topics
• Experience in strategic planning
• Negotiating knowledge of German and English Preferably:
• Completed studies in business administration, health economics, economics, medical technology or a comparable discipline
• Several years of leadership experience
• Experience in the marketing of capital goods, in particular through efficient project management and the use of financing solutions
• Experience in endoscopy/sport medicine
• Knowledge of the Swiss healthcare system as well as the settlement and refund systems there
• Solid network in the hospital and hospital environment as well as strong networking ability with pleasure in building and maintaining relationships
• Good knowledge of French and/or Italian Additional information
• Travel activity is about 70%.
• Depending on the planning of your workweek, you are the remaining time in the home office.
• Your residence should be within Switzerland.
• Information about the product portfolio can be found under the following links: Visualization, Sports Medicine, OP infrastructure and networking
• Please submit your application documents in English. Diversity is important to us. We welcome applications from people regardless of their ethnic, national or social origin, gender, disability, age or sexual identity. Travel Percentage: 70%

jobs.title: Berufsbildner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite

In dieser Rolle gestalten Sie aktiv die Ausbildung der nächsten Generation von Fachkräften im technischen Umfeld. Sie vermitteln praxisnahe Fertigkeiten und begleiten Lernende von der Ausbildung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Ihr Beitrag stellt sicher, dass zukünftige Mitarbeitende optimal auf die Anforderungen im Produktionsumfeld vorbereitet sind.

Unser Angebot an Sie

• Sie führen die praktische und theoretische Ausbildung von Polymechaniker/innen und Produktionsmechaniker/innen durch

• Sie kontrollieren und bewerten die ausgeführten Aufgaben sowie den Lernfortschritt der Auszubildenden

• Sie vermitteln Kenntnisse in der manuellen und maschinellen Fertigungstechnik

• Sie führen Lernende in CNC-Technologien ein

• Sie unterstützen die Vorbereitung auf Teil- und Abschlussprüfungen

• Sie wirken bei der Rekrutierung von Lernenden und Organisation von Berufsmessen mit

• Sie dokumentieren und bewerten die Lern- und Leistungsentwicklung strukturiert

• Sie fördern die Entwicklung in den Bereichen Fach-, Methoden-, Sozial- und Selbstkompetenz sowie in Projekten zu Lean und Arbeitssicherheit

Das zeichnet Sie aus
Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Polymechaniker EFZ

• Minimum 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Produktionsumfeld

• Nachweisbare Kenntnisse in manueller und maschineller Fertigungstechnik

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit CNC-Technologien

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Weiterbildung im technischen Umfeld (z.B. Produktionsfachmann HF)

• Erste Erfahrung in der Anleitung oder Ausbildung von Lernenden

• Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit an Projekten im Produktionsumfeld

Additional Information

• Arbeitsort: Selzach, Schweiz

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Berufsbildung und dem Produktionsteam

• Fokus auf langfristige Entwicklung von Nachwuchskräften im technischen Bereich

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen ungeachtet ihrer ethnischen, nationalen oder sozialen Herkunft, des Geschlechts, einer Behinderung, des Alters oder ihrer sexuellen Identität.

Ihre Bewerbung
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Online-Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und inklusive aller relevanten Dokumente (Anschreiben, aktueller Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, ggf. Arbeitserlaubnis). Laden Sie bitte unter dem Punkt „Lebenslauf“ alle Anhänge direkt hoch.

Falls Sie bereits in Besitz einer Arbeitsbewilligung sind, bitten wir Sie die genaue Bewilligungsart mit Ihrer Bewerbung hochzuladen.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass der Anzeigentitel vom internen Stellentitel abweichen kann.

Travel Percentage: 0%

Das zeichnet Sie aus
Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Studienabschluss HF oder FH (Bachelor oder Master) in Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Industrial Engineering, Fertigungstechnik, Supply Chain Management, Prozessmanagement und Wirtschaftsinformatik

• Minimum 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung von Lean-Projekten im Produktionsumfeld

• Nachweisbare Kenntnisse in Lean-Methoden (z. B. Wertstromanalyse, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, TPM, PDCA)

• Erfahrung im Einsatz von MS365, Power Automate und Power BI

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

• Englisch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau

• Zertifizierung im Lean- oder Prozessmanagement (z. B. Lean Management, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt oder Yellow Belt)

• Erfahrung mit digitalen Visualisierungs- und Kollaborationstools (z. B. Miro)

• Kenntnisse in Layoutgestaltung und Materialflussanalyse

Additional Information

• Arbeitsort: Produktionsumfeld im Werk

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Job Title: RAQA Specialist (m/f/d) – Regulatory Affairs & Quality Systems

Job Summary:
As a RAQA Specialist, you will support Regulatory Affairs and Quality activities for our business across Germany, Switzerland, and Austria (GSA), with a strong focus on Swiss registration requirements. You will help ensure compliance with MDR 2017/745 and applicable Swiss legislation (e.g., MedDO), drive product registration and maintenance activities (including Swissmedic/Swiss regulatory applications such as Swissdamed), and support continuous improvement of Quality Management System (QMS) processes. Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and global teams, you will contribute to a compliant, efficient, and continuously improving RAQA organization.

What will you do
· Support product registration and lifecycle maintenance activities for Switzerland (and GSA as applicable), including preparation, review, and maintenance of regulatory documentation and registrations.
• · Coordinate and support Swiss regulatory submissions/notifications and system activities (e.g., Swissdamed and related Swissmedic applications), ensuring data quality, completeness, and compliance.
• · Support the monitoring of regulatory requirements (MDR and Swiss MedDO) and support impact assessments and implementation of changes.
• · Provide day-to-day RAQA process support to internal stakeholders (e.g., Supply Chain, Customer Service, Technical Service, Commercial), including guidance on local regulatory requirements.
• · Support QMS processes and documentation (e.g., SOP updates, records management, training support) and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• · Support internal and external audits and inspection readiness activities related to RA/QA topics.
• · Contribute to cross-functional projects and governance initiatives to strengthen RAQA processes and interfaces.

What will you need
• Required
• · Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field. Master’s is a plus.
• · 2+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance (RAQA) or a related role in a medical device, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industry.
· Practical experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: regulatory submissions/registrations, product registration maintenance, QMS process support, change control documentation, or regulatory compliance activities.
• · Proficiency in English and German, with strong communication and collaboration skills.
• Preferred
• · Knowledge of MDR 2017/745 and Swiss medical device legislation (e.g., MedDO), and an understanding of Swiss market requirements (e.g., CH-REP/Swiss registration concepts).
• · Experience with Swiss regulatory tools/systems (e.g., Swissdamed) or comparable registration databases and data maintenance activities.
• · Experience supporting QMS documentation processes (e.g., SOP changes, training deployment, audit support).
• · Confident stakeholder management skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Travel Percentage: 10%

• · Coordinare e sostenere le presentazioni/notifiche normative svizzere e le attività di sistema (ad esempio, applicazioni Swissdamed e relative Swissmedic), garantendo qualità, completezza e conformità dei dati.
• · Sostenere il monitoraggio dei requisiti normativi (MDR e Swiss MedDO) e sostenere le valutazioni di impatto e l'attuazione dei cambiamenti.
• · Fornire supporto di processo RAQA di giorno per giorno a stakeholder interni (ad esempio, Supply Chain, Servizio Clienti, Servizio Tecnico, Commerciale), comprese le indicazioni sui requisiti normativi locali.
• · Supporta processi e documentazione QMS (ad esempio, aggiornamenti SOP, gestione record, supporto formativo) e contribuisce a iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• · Supporto di audit interni ed esterni e attività di prontezza di ispezione relative agli argomenti RA/QA.
• · Contribuire a progetti interfunzionali e iniziative di governance per rafforzare i processi e le interfacce RAQA.

· L'esperienza pratica in uno o più dei seguenti settori è preferita: presentazioni di regolamentazione/registrazioni, manutenzione della registrazione del prodotto, supporto di processo QMS, documentazione di controllo del cambiamento, o attività di conformità normativa.
• · Proficienza in inglese e tedesco, con forti capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione.

You will be responsible for the overall management of your region; developing and leading your team, and taking ownership for sales performance and budgets within your territory. The role also contributes to broader country-level commercial execution by supporting strategic initiatives, key accounts, and therapy adoption priorities aligned with EMEA objectives.

Opportunities for maximising customer service along with acquiring new customers will be a pivotal part of your role, so a proven history of delivering exceptional results (individually and through your team) over an extended period is key. You will passionately drive performance with accountability & integrity.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting directly into the regional BUM, you will lead a sales team to ensure that financial & performance objectives are met.

• Accurately forecast business and drive a sustainable, long-term regional sales pipeline aligned with country and EMEA priorities.

• Attract, develop, engage and lead a high performing sales team, supporting and driving them to accelerate business.

• Support and collaborate with our Enabling Function teams (Marketing, Medical, Reimbursement, Order-to-Cash) to ensure a smooth Order to Cash process is maintained and our customers receive the highest levels of service.

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key regional and national healthcare systems, key accounts, and influential stakeholders.

• Monitor and analyse sales performance metrics (revenue, activities, conversion rates) and take corrective actions as necessary.

• Embrace & enable change to simplify, scale & innovate, acting as a senior commercial role model within the region.

• Demonstrate proficiency in leading complex sales cycles typically defined as six months or longer with multiple partners, decision-makers, and influencers at multiple levels.

• Provide input into regional business planning, market development initiatives, and therapy adoption strategies in collaboration with region and EMEA leadership.

This role will require approximately 50-70% of travel to attend customer sites, along with travel to local, national, and EMEA meetings as required.

Bachelor’s degree preferred in a related field or equivalent commercial and clinical experience.

• Commercial skills in leading a profit centre, with experience contributing beyond a single territory to broader market or regional objectives.

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Purpose of Job:
Serves as the global subject matter expert and strategic leader for Product Use Information and labeling, driving compliance, governance, and transformation initiatives that support market access, business continuity, and the safe and effective use of medical devices throughout their lifecycle.
Acts as a strategic partner to global business functions and serves as a key liaison between cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and regulatory authorities. Drives Product Use Information objectives across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Clinical Affairs, and other business functions to ensure consistent, compliant, and efficient labeling processes.
Provides leadership for complex, cross-functional labeling initiatives, overseeing all project phases from strategy and planning through execution and implementation. Defines project scope, priorities, resource requirements, and delivery plans to achieve business objectives while managing risks and ensuring compliance.
Leads initiatives that advance labeling excellence through process optimization, digital transformation, and the implementation of innovative technologies, enabling greater efficiency, scalability, and quality across the product portfolio.
Demonstrates a strong commitment to patient safety, product quality, and regulatory compliance, consistently upholding the organization's Quality Policy, ethical standards, and company values while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence

What You'll Do:

• Lead the development, maintenance, and lifecycle management of compliant product labeling in accordance with global regulatory requirements, international standards, and quality system requirements. Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, Packaging, Medical/Clinical Affairs, and Quality, from concept through regulatory release.

• Represent the Labeling function during internal and external audits and inspections, ensuring regulatory compliance and effective resolution of audit observations.

• Drive investigation and resolution of non-conformances by identifying root causes, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and ensuring sustainable compliance improvements.

• Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) due diligence activities by assessing labeling, regulatory, and quality system impacts and identifying integration requirements and risks.

• Assess and interpret emerging regulations, standards, guidance documents, and quality agreements to define compliant implementation strategies for both legacy product portfolios and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs.

• Serve as Division Process Owner (DPO) for the Product Use Publications Quality Management System landscape, overseeing governance, periodic reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and the development of best-practice guidance. Maintain ownership of DQP 16-001, the overarching procedure governing both Labels and Labeling processes.

• Develop and deliver training programs to ensure effective adoption of labeling processes, systems, and compliance requirements across the organization.

• Lead multiple concurrent, high-complexity labeling initiatives across new product development, sustaining engineering, mergers and acquisitions, and regulatory remediation programs and leads the initiative for more project transparency within the team.

• Manage strategic cross-functional projects supporting medical device development, product lifecycle management, implementation of new regulatory requirements, and deployment of innovative technologies and systems that enhance labeling creation, review, compliance, and operational efficiency.

• Drive digital transformation and process modernization initiatives to improve scalability, automation, quality, and efficiency of global labeling operations.

What You'll Need:

• Experience in highly regulated field, ideal

Definisce la portata del progetto, le priorità, i requisiti delle risorse e i piani di consegna per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali mentre gestiscono i rischi e garantiscono la conformità.
Conduce iniziative che promuovono l'etichettatura dell'eccellenza attraverso l'ottimizzazione dei processi, la trasformazione digitale e l'implementazione di tecnologie innovative, consentendo una maggiore efficienza, scalabilità e qualità nel portafoglio prodotti.
Dimostra un forte impegno per la sicurezza dei pazienti, la qualità dei prodotti e la conformità alle normative, mantenendo costantemente la Politica di Qualità dell'organizzazione, gli standard etici e i valori aziendali, promuovendo una cultura di miglioramento continuo e di eccellenza operativa

• Condurre lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dell'etichettatura dei prodotti conformi in conformità con i requisiti normativi globali, gli standard internazionali e i requisiti del sistema di qualità. • Guidare l'indagine e la risoluzione di non-conformanze identificando cause radice, implementando azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA), e garantendo miglioramenti di conformità sostenibili.

• Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) attività di due diligence valutando l'etichettatura, le normative e gli impatti del sistema di qualità e l'identificazione dei requisiti e dei rischi di integrazione.

• Valutare e interpretare le normative emergenti, gli standard, i documenti di guida e gli accordi di qualità per definire le strategie di implementazione conformi sia per i portfolio di prodotti legacy che per i programmi New Product Introduzione (NPI).

• Servire come proprietario del processo di divisione (DPO) per il paesaggio del sistema di gestione della qualità di utilizzo del prodotto, supervisionando la governance, revisioni periodiche, iniziative di miglioramento continuo, e lo sviluppo di una guida migliore pratica. Mantenere la proprietà di DQP 16-001, la procedura di overarching che regola sia i processi di Etichetta e Etichettatura.

• Sviluppare e fornire programmi di formazione per garantire l'adozione efficace dei processi di etichettatura, sistemi e requisiti di conformità in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Condurre molteplici iniziative di etichettatura concomitante e ad alta complessità attraverso il nuovo sviluppo del prodotto, sostenendo l'ingegneria, le fusioni e le acquisizioni, e programmi di bonifica regolamentare e conduce l'iniziativa per una maggiore trasparenza del progetto all'interno del team.

• Gestisci progetti strategici interfunzionali che supportano lo sviluppo di dispositivi medici, la gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto, l'implementazione di nuovi requisiti normativi e l'implementazione di tecnologie e sistemi innovativi che migliorano la creazione, la revisione, la conformità e l'efficienza operativa.

• Guidare le iniziative di digital transformation e modernizzazione dei processi per migliorare la scalabilità, l'automazione, la qualità e l'efficienza delle operazioni di etichettatura globali.

Cosa ti serve:

• Esperienza in campo altamente regolamentato, ideale
